claim: The spec makes tracker labels a mandatory contract surface. arch_idempotency_labeler.md requires every create op to carry idempotency.label = spex:<eid>; arch_changeset_builder.md mandates labels=["spex:cleanup"] on cleanup creates and ["spex:obsolete", "commit:<HEAD>"] on close ops; arch_br_reference_adapter.md builds the create-idempotency check (b8d894dff9b5) and the close-skip check (7bad082a34b6) on those labels as required behavior. Together they make label support a precondition for any conformant tracker and labels a required field of the changeset.
authoritative_source: The authoring decision behind 2026-08-11-event-keyed-linkage, stated by the author during that proposal's discussion and reaffirmed on 2026-08-17: with the task journal in place, linkage and classification are trackable from the journal and receipts alone; labels are optional adapter-side insurance, no label is mandatory, no backward-compatibility shapes are owed (no release exists), and spex must be able to work with a tracker that has no label support at all. The proposal text encoded a narrower rule — spex:<eid> scoped to create idempotency, with the spex:cleanup / spex:obsolete / commit:<HEAD> markers carved out as untouched — so this is an author-filed intent-encoding defect, not a mid-task discovery by the anchoring bead's implementer.
evidence: Every fact the mandated labels encode already lives elsewhere by the spec's own design. Linkage: the journal's task_created {for: <eid>, task_id} line is the pairing, and BeadReader reads no labels (arch_idempotency_labeler.md itself calls the label an adapter-facing key spex reads nothing from). Cleanup classification: derivable from the changeset op shape and the journal's removed-event lineage. Close state: the tracker's own status field. Crash-retry dedup: receipts (op_id -> bead_id) once written; the label only narrows the window before the first receipt. The contract therefore mandates a surface none of whose consumers is load-bearing for spex, while excluding label-less trackers that the intent explicitly wants supported — the label mandate and the journal's role as the sole linkage store contradict each other.
proposed_fix: Re-describe the label surface as optional insurance end to end: idempotency.label becomes an optional changeset field an adapter MAY probe before create (its absence degrades only the crash-retry dedup window — an accepted cost, stated in the leaf); retire the spex:cleanup discriminator and the spex:obsolete + commit:<HEAD> close markers, re-keying close idempotency (7bad082a34b6) on tracker status (closing a closed bead is a no-op) and cleanup discrimination on journal/bead-id lookups; shrink the adapter minimum contract from create/close/label/identifier to create/close/identifier. The fix is bead-producing across the labeler, builder, adapter contract and their test leaves, so refresh cannot absorb it — expect a mint under the in-flight 2026-08-13-plan-module epic at the step-4 decision.
